id: title:Gilbert09:make row tracking survive redis and billing blips

review.reason: The diff implements specific reliability improvements for the data ingestion pipeline: it introduces typed error handling for billing services to preserve context, configures Redis connectivity defaults to prevent false positives in non-test environments, and adds retry logic with 'fail-open' strategies for transient Redis errors (read-only replicas, misconfiguration). TheseObs
review.posthog_relevance: Improves the robustness of the data warehouse row tracking and billing limit enforcement mechanisms by preventing crashes on transient infrastructure issues and ensuring accurate count calculations despite temporary connection blips.
review.uncertainty: Cannot verify the full production impact or whether these specific error paths were previously causing data loss or service interruptions without seeing the complete implementation context and historical incident data.

observations.behavior: Replaces generic Exception with a typed BillingServiceResponseError that preserves status_code and body, and changes error handling to use this specific exception type instead of catching JSONDecodeError separately.

observations.posthog_connection: Prevents false-positive connection failures for data warehouse row tracking in deployments that rely on the shared REDIS_URL instead of a dedicated instance.
